name: Alpine Microphone Mount | '16 - '23 Tacoma
description:
Alpine Microphone Mount – 2016–2023 Toyota Tacoma
We’re proud to offer a clean, factory-style solution for mounting your Alpine aftermarket microphone into the headliner console of your 2016–2023 Toyota Tacoma. This mount allows your microphone to be neatly integrated into the OEM location while maintaining excellent voice clarity and functionality.

Installation Instructions



Remove the Headliner Console

Gently pull down on the headliner console to release the pressure clips.
Use a plastic panel removal tool to avoid damage during removal.

Disconnect Console Wiring

Unplug the wiring harness connector from the console.

Remove Foam Insert

Locate the factory microphone port and remove the foam insert.

Install the Microphone into the Mount

Push the rounded end of the microphone through the opening of the mount.
Make sure the rounded end sits close to the bottom of the center mount support.


Mount the Assembly into the Console

Insert the mount into the headliner console with the legs and rounded end of the microphone facing down.
Press until the clip locks securely into place.

Route the Microphone Wire

Route the wire from the headliner console toward the rearview mirror.
Reinstall the console, pulling any slack toward the mirror.
Continue routing the wire across the top of the windshield, down the driver’s side A-pillar, and toward the floorboard.
Run the wire under the dash and plug the 3.5mm jack into the red microphone port on the back of your Alpine head unit.

Test the System

Power on the head unit and test the microphone to ensure it is working properly.

description:
Introducing our 2014 - 2021 Tundra JBL Amp Bypass Harness, designed to simplify the installation process for your aftermarket amplifier while preserving your vehicle's audio system integrity. This harness is specifically crafted for 2014-2021 Tundra vehicles equipped with the JBL audio system, providing a seamless solution for bypassing the factory JBL amplifier. By utilizing our bypass harness, you can effortlessly upgrade your sound system, ensuring a clean, professional install without cutting into your vehicle's factory wiring.
Connecting the JBL Bypass Harness to your amplifier:

Rear Left + Green
Rear Left - Green/Black Stripe
Rear Right + Purple
Rear Right - Purple/Black Stripe
Front Left + White
Front Left - White/Black Stripe
Front Right + Grey
Front Right - Grey/Black Stripe
SUB – Black

Included In Kit:

1x Tundra Amp Bypass Harness
10x Wire Ferrules
10x Fork Terminals

JBL Amplified or Non-JBL Amplified?

If you have a JBL logo on the top of your door speakers then you have a JBL Amplified System.
If you don’t have a JBL logo on your door speakers but you have an amplifier under your drivers side or passenger side seat then you have a non-JBL Amplified System.
If you do not have a JBL logo on the top of your door speakers nor have an amplifier under your drivers side or passenger side seat then you have a Non-Amplified System.

The package includes everything you need for a smooth installation: the Tundra JBL amp bypass harness, 10 wire ferrules, and 10 fork terminals. These additional connectors are included for compatibility, allowing you to connect easily to whichever amplifier you choose. Wire ferrules help ensure a secure and reliable connection to the amp’s terminals, while fork terminals provide flexibility in case your new amplifier’s input requires them. With these components, you'll have the adaptability to set up a reliable, high-quality connection for your amplifier, maintaining system performance without compromising on quality.
Our bypass harness is a plug-and-play solution that respects your vehicle’s original wiring, allowing for easy installation and removal if needed. By bypassing the factory JBL amp, you’re free to tap into your new amplifier’s full potential, unlocking richer sound and deeper bass.
Whether you’re a DIY enthusiast or prefer a professional install, our JBL Amp Bypass Harness package has you covered, making it easy to enhance your sound system without the hassle. Upgrade your 2014-2021 Tundra JBL-equipped vehicle with confidence, knowing you have a reliable solution that maintains both performance and the integrity of your vehicle’s wiring.

description:
How to install your Mic Mount

Install Microphone To Mount. Route the 3.5mm jack end through the bottom end of the mount. Pull all slack through and secure microphone into mount. Rounded end of microphone should be inline with 2 legs on mount.

Route Microphone Wire. Start by routing microphone wire from headliner console area through headliner towards rearview mirror. At this point, you can re-install the headliner console. Tuck the wire behind the A pillar cover and route down the A pillar toward the drivers floorboard. name: Sony Microphone Mount | '16 - '23 Tacoma
description:
How to install your Mic Mount


































We are proud to offer you a solution for mounting your Sony aftermarket microphone in your 2016 – 2023 Tacoma’s headliner console.
This allows your new microphone to be neatly tucked away in the headliner console and maintains the level of voice clarity and function you expect.
Installation Steps


Remove Headliner Console.– The headliner console is typically held in with pressure clips and can be removed by pulling straight down. It is recommended to use gently pressure with a panel removal tool to pry the headliner console out.

Remove Headliner Console Wiring Harness. Unplug harness connector.

Remove Foam Insert. Locate microphone port and remove the foam insert.

Remove Mounting Ball On Sony Microphone. The small ball can be removed easily by cutting with a pair of side cutters or a utility knife.

Install Microphone To Mount. Push the rounded end of the microphone thru upper support of the mount. The rounded end of microphone should be very close to in line with the bottom of the 2 legs on mount. Align the spot where you cut off the ball to be in-line with one of the upper supports. This will make sure the audio openings on the side of the microphone are not obstructed.

Install Sony Microphone Mount. Install mount into headliner console. Insert mount (legs & rounded end of microphone facing down) until the clip locks into place.

Route Microphone Wire. Start by routing microphone wire from headliner console area through headliner towards rearview mirror. At this point, you can re-install the headliner console. Be sure to pull excess slack toward the rearview mirror while reinstalling headliner console. Continue routing the wire along the top of the windshield toward the driver side A pillar. Tuck the wire behind the A pillar cover and route down the A pillar toward the driver’s floorboard. Run the wire under the dash area and finish by routing the 3.5mm jack to the back of your new Sony Bundle. Connect the 3.5mm jack into the red mic port on the rear of the Sony radio chassis.

Test Functionality. Test functionality after making all required connections.

name: Dash Camera Power Adapter | '05 - '23 Tacoma
description:
Toyota Tacoma Dash Camera Power Adapter Install

















What's My Pin Count? 
The pin count for your dash camera power adapter can vary depending on your vehicle. Here’s a quick guide to help you identify the right one:


7-pin: Typically found on 2003–2019 Toyota 4Runners with an auto-dimming rearview mirror. The adapter connects directly to the back of the mirror, no need to access the overhead console.

10-pin: Typically used in 2020–2024 Toyota 4Runners and is accessed via the vehicle’s overhead console.

12-pin: Typically associated with 2014+ Toyota Tundras, some 2010+ 4Runners and 2016–2023 Toyota Tacomas. These usually connect to the back of the rearview mirror. 

14-pin: Typically related to 2005–2015 Toyota Tacomas or 2007–2013 Toyota Tundras. These usually connect to the back of the rearview mirror. 

Again, this is a helpful guide but please be sure to check your vehicle's pin count before purchasing to ensure compatibility!
Dash Camera Power Adapter Overview
Details: Use our Dash Camera Power Adapter to plug your dash camera into the power connector on the back of your rearview mirror and you're up and running.
Plug & Play: The power adapter harness in our kit will plug directly into the power source for your factory rearview mirror. Check out the video above for details! Our kit takes about 10 minutes to install!
Plug & Play Compatibility: In order for this bundle to be compatible with your 4Runner it does require you have an auto-dimming rearview mirror or a rearview mirror with an LCD backup camera screen.
Included: 1x plug and play power harness, 1x USB-C to USB adapter, 1x micro-USB to USB adapter, 1x zip tie

name: Jeep Wrangler 4 Door Second Row Seat Delete Plate System - Infill Panels

V2 seat deletes (SKU 1484-GGR-SH - 40% & 1485-GGR-SH - 60%) will come with infill panels as part of the system.  There is no need to order them separately, and the V2 panels are a different shape than the original V1 panels.  V2 Seat Deletes came on the market 02/01/25.
Designed to be 100% bolt on and easy to add with three 1/4-20x3/4" screws and three roll-in t-nuts and hardware to mount to your existing extrusion channel under the seat delete.
They are available as a single piece and they will fit either the 40% or 60% seat deletes. Also available to purchase as a pair if you already have the 40 and 60% deletes.
Jeep Wrangler JKU Seat Delete Plate Systems: JKUs will use these original Infill Panels, but due to minor changes in construction of our seat deletes, older models may not be able to use the third mounting hole towards the rear of the vehicle. This is still structurally sound and will still perform the function you are looking for but it will be with 2 bolts instead of 3 bolts.
This product is NOT currently compatible with the Jeep Wrangler 4xe. 
Infill Panels do not currently fit some 2024 and newer Wranglers with the Premium Cabin Package (due to thicker carpet, insulation and additional electrical wiring).

name: Goose Gear Strap Kit
description:
The Goose Gear Strap Kit is Made in the USA of domestic and imported materials.
The kit consists of 4 straps that measure 48" long with 1" wide webbing. Our webbing selection is Made in the USA, is UV stable and is a military grade product, yet is much thinner than the less expensive strap materials commonly found in imported strap kits. The cam buckle is also larger than most on the market for superior strength and ease of use.
We have also added a Velcro wrapping sleeve to secure the excess strap length for a clean installation. This also eliminate the need to cut the straps and melt the cut ends to prevent fraying. Additionally, since we are using the higher quality strap material, the excess strap rolls up into a thin roll for a clean and less cluttered installation.
The Kit includes 4 straps.
Strap testing as certified by Applied Technical Services, LLC an ISO 9001 Company, July 26, 2021 359287 - Average breaking force is 703 lbf.
Straps are not certified for overhead use and should never be used in this way. Maximum recommended use is 200 lbf. Do not use these straps on humans or animals or to secure humans or animals in any way.
Each strap weighs 3 ounces, pack of 4 weighs 1 pound

name: Rivian - R1T - 2022-Present - 1st Gen - 4.5' Bed - Explore Series -  UltraLite - GFC
description:
Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC

Go Fast Campers (GFC) partnered with us to develop the ultimate interior for their V2 Pro Camper, specifically tailored to the Rivian R1T. Both companies share a vision of maintaining high standards by keeping all manufacturing in the USA, ensuring top-quality craftsmanship.
Upgrade your Rivian R1T with the Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC, a modular storage solution designed for versatility and ease of use. Whether you need secure storage, a flat work surface, or a fully configurable system, this setup allows you to customize it to fit your needs—all while maintaining access to the R1T’s under-bed spare tire storage.


CONFIGURATION OPTIONS

The Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC offers multiple configurations to match your setup:
✔ Bed Cargo Module – A secure, strap-in storage solution utilizing factory anchor points while preserving access to the under-bed spare tire compartment. Compatible with optional Step 22 Stingray Flat Box bags for enhanced organization.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side – A flat-packable, lockable storage module that installs on the driver’s side.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side – The same versatile module, designed for the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side Package – Combines the Bed Cargo Module with the Bench and Storage Module on the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side Package – A package including the Bed Cargo Module and Bench and Storage Module on the driver side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Modules - Full Package – The ultimate setup, featuring the Bed Cargo Module along with Bench and Storage Modules on both driver and passenger sides for maximum storage and utility.

For added versatility, you can also integrate the Flat Deck Panels (SKU 1162-GGR-SH) to create a flush surface, perfect for additional workspace or securing gear. The MaxLite™ extrusion underneath adds strength and support for rugged adventures.

This system is designed to work seamlessly with the Rivian R1T’s factory bed lighting, ensuring visibility in all conditions. It also maintains easy access to key factory features, allowing you to open and access the under-bed gear tunnel and spare tire storage compartment without removing the system.
With a fully modular design, the Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC adapts to your needs—whether you’re gearing up for a weekend adventure or optimizing your truck for daily use. Configure it your way and take your setup to the next level.
Products shown inside modules are not included.

description:
The Ford F250-F350 second row seat deletes for the Crew Cab 4 door are designed for you to easily remove your rear seats and create a flat and secure platform to secure your gear to. The platform includes hatches that allow access to the factory storage space below the rear seats. In addition to the base plate, you also get a back wall replacement that is secured to the base plate and the factory anchors points in the back wall.

The addition of the back wall gives you ample space to secure other gear if necessary, such as fire extinguishers, first aid kits and other personal gear.
For the design, we utilized our preferred design of 60/40 split. This design allows the user to add a fridge or cooler behind the passenger's seat in a front to back orientation. Keeping the 60% space wide open and usable. Fridge models that would easily fit in this space include:

National Luna Weekender 50 and 52, Legacy 40 and 52
Dometic CFX3 35, 45 and 55
ARB Classic 35, 47 and Zero 38 and 47
SnoMaster TR42 and CL40
Other fridge models can certainly fit in this space. our recommended maximum dimensions for this area are 28"w x 18"d x 22"h

Product Specifications: 

Product Weight

40% Seat Delete: 21 lbs. (5319)
60% Seat Delete: 32 lbs. (5027)



AIR BAG ISSUES
Air Bag Warning Light may be triggered. Below are photos of how one customer plugged in components that eliminated the air bag warning light on his higher end King Ranch Edition. We expect the same from the Platinum and Limited versions as well.

The seat belt coil and the black box, which has to be removed from the rear seat need to be plugged in to defeat the air bag warning light.

Please note: There is a possibility of airbag warning light activation for seat deletes installed on 2020-present Ford F150 and F250-550 Super Duty models, including King Ranch, Platinum, and Limited trims. The only way to eliminate the Air Bag warning light is to connect the seat belt coil and the small black box back into the factory plugs. This is a lot of stuff that now needs to be hidden away somewhere safe. We recommend wrapping it in something to keep it quiet and stuffing it under the seat delete towards the rear of the vehicle.

name: Toyota Tacoma - 2016-2023 - 3rd Gen - 6’ Bed - Explore Series - UltraLite - GFC
description:
Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC

Upgrade your Toyota Tacoma (3rd Gen, 2016-2023) with a 6’ bed using the Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC, a modular storage solution designed for versatility and ease of use. Whether you need secure storage, a flat work surface, or a fully configurable system, this setup allows you to customize it to fit your needs.


CONFIGURATION OPTIONS:

The Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC offers multiple configurations to match your setup:
✔ Bed Cargo Module – A secure, strap-in storage solution utilizing factory anchor points. Compatible with optional Step 22 Stingray Flat Box bags for enhanced organization.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side – A flat-packable, lockable storage module that installs on the driver’s side.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side – The same versatile module, designed for the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side Package – Combines the Bed Cargo Module with the Bench and Storage Module on the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side Package – A package including the Bed Cargo Module and Bench and Storage Module on the driver side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Full Package – The ultimate setup, featuring the Bed Cargo Modulealong with Bench and Storage Modules on both driver and passenger sides for maximum storage and utility.
For added versatility, you can also integrate the Flat Deck Panel (SKU 4084-GGR-SH) to create a flush surface, perfect for additional workspace or securing gear.
With a fully modular design, the Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC adapts to your needs—whether you’re gearing up for a weekend adventure or optimizing your truck for daily use. Configure it your way and take your setup to the next level.
Products shown inside modules are not included.

name: Ford - F150 2021-Present - 14th Gen. SuperCrew - Second Row Seat Delete Plate System with Factory B&O Subwoofer Center Wall with Exterior Port
description:
The Ford F150 second row seat deletes for the Super Crew 4 door F150 are designed for you to easily remove your rear seats and create a flat and secure platform to secure your gear to. The platform includes hatches that allow access to the factory storage space below the rear seats. In addition to the base plate, you also get a back wall replacement that is secured to the base plate and the factory anchors points in the back wall. 
This product is designed to match the factory seat layout: 

40% Passenger Side Seat Delete (5319)
60% Driver Side Seat Delete with B&O Center Mounted Subwoofer (5027)

Run both Seat Deletes for a 100% Second Row Seat Delete
This unit is 100% bolt in and does not require drilling. This system is designed to work around the factory subwoofer.
The addition of the back wall gives you ample space to secure other gear if necessary, such as fire extinguishers, first aid kits and other personal gear.
For the design, we utilized our preferred design of 60/40 split. This design allows the user to add a fridge or cooler behind the passenger's seat in a front to back orientation. Keeping the 60% space wide open and usable. Fridge models that would easily fit in this space include:

National Luna Weekender 50 and 52, Legacy 40 and 52
Dometic CFX3 35, 45 and 55
ARB Classic 35, 47 and Zero 38 and 47
SnoMaster TR42 and CL40
Other fridge models can certainly fit in this space. our recommended maximum dimensions for this area are 28"w x 18"d x 22"h

Product Specifications: 

Product Weight

40% Seat Delete: 21 lbs. (5319)
60% Seat Delete: 32 lbs. (5027)



AIR BAG ISSUES
Air Bag Warning Light may be triggered. Below are photos of how one customer plugged in components that eliminated the air bag warning light on his higher end King Ranch Edition. We expect the same from the Platinum and Limited versions as well.

The seat belt coil and the black box, which has to be removed from the rear seat need to be plugged in to defeat the air bag warning light.

Please note: There is a possibility of airbag warning light activation for seat deletes installed on 2020-present Ford F150 and F250-550 Super Duty models, including King Ranch, Platinum, and Limited trims. The only way to eliminate the Air Bag warning light is to connect the seat belt coil and the small black box back into the factory plugs. This is a lot of stuff that now needs to be hidden away somewhere safe. We recommend wrapping it in something to keep it quiet and stuffing it under the seat delete towards the rear of the vehicle.

name: Jeep Wrangler 2018-2023 JLU 4 Door - Second Row Seat Delete Plate System - 8" or 10" Module Based
description:
Jeep Wrangler 2018-2023 JLU 4 Door
This version of the second row delete is module based which means it is a raised platform that is designed to mount to the rear of our 8" and 10" Drawer Modules, CampKitchen 2.31 and IceBox 1.31 Modules. Below the seat delete is an incredible amount of storage for all of your camping and other needs. There are access doors on both side and the top for quick and easy access regardless of what is secured on top of the delete.
There is also a pillow extension sleeping platform in the kit. This platform installs with a simple thumb screw and a strap to wrap around the front seat headrest stems. When the pillow extension is not in use, it can be secured to the front leg of the seat delete with the same thumb screws. Setup and teardown are less than a few minutes each.
Jeep Wrangler 2018-2023 JLU Seat Delete Plate System for the Second Row is available to order for the 60% Passenger Seat and 40% Drivers Seat or can be combined to create a 100% second row delete.
Jeep Wrangler JLU Rear Plate System and 8", 10" modules or the CampKitchen 2.31 or IceBox 1.31 are required to install the Seat Delete Plate System.
The 10" version platforms will also work with the 28" Dometic Fridge Drawer 30-liter Module.
This system is compatible with the factory subwoofer and without the factory subwoofer.
The 60% Passenger Seat Delete Plate System is a bolt in replacement for the 60% passengers' side second row seat. With this platform you get three storage access doors and all necessary hardware to bolt it to the vehicle at factory anchor points, and to attach it to whichever storage module is best for your build, no drilling required. If you are installing just the 60% delete you will need to own or purchase a 60% Seat Delete Bracket. This kit DOES NOT include the Jeep JLU Rear Plate System, modules or the 60% rear seat delete bracket.
Seat delete bracket can be found here
The 40% Driver Seat Delete Plate System is a bolt in replacement for the 40% drivers' side second row seat. With this platform you get three storage access doors and all necessary hardware to bolt it to the vehicle at factory anchor points without drilling, and to anchor points to attach it to whichever storage module is best for you build. This kit DOES NOT include the Jeep JLU Rear Plate System, modules or the rear seat delete bracket.
Available for 8" and 10" module heights as well as the CampKitchen 2.31 and IceBox 1.31 and IceBox with Top Drawer 1.31.
This Plate System is NOT compatible with the Jeep Wrangler 4xe.
Module Based Second Row Seat Deletes do not currently fit 2024 and newer Wranglers - It will be available in the future. If you are interested, please reach out to see if you and your rig can be a product development candidate.
The Goose Gear plate system and sleeping platform for the Jeep JLU are direct bolt in units and require no drilling into your vehicle for model years 2018-2023. Designed and built with industrial grade plywood and coating using our propriety spray methods for superior durability and wear resistance.

40% Usable Space: Roughly 31" x 19" measured at the top of the plate. description:
This product will require removal of factory seats for the system to be installed. The Seat Delete Plate System is does not require the removal of the factory subwoofer and it leaves the factory back wall intact.
The Toyota Tundra 3rd Generation DoubleCab Second Row Seat Delete Plate System provides a secure and flat mounting and storage solution for your vehicle.

The second-row deletes are available as a 40% Passenger Side Delete without Back Wall OR 60% Driver Side Delete without Back Wall. Ordering both 40% and 60% will create a 100% completed platform. 
The DoubleCab Seat Delete includes the Seat Delete Plate System without the Back Wall, opening the second row of the truck creating a massive platform perfect for a bike, pet, refrigerator, cargo boxes etc.
The amount of space created by removing the seats is far more than most people expect and they find that they are able to store quite a bit of gear that would normally not fit. Below the seat delete is also a great place to store heavier items, lower in the vehicle and near the middle of the vehicle for a lower center of gravity than if you were to store those items in the bed of the truck.

This L Bracket installation method means you can slide the panel forward and rearward as you so choose. For example, you simply want a clean fill panel at the front of your Canopy camper that is in close to alignment with the optional Alu-Cabin water tank. This panel can do just that. Difference between Body Lifts and Suspension Lifts
Body Lift – A body lift raises the truck’s body away from the frame using spacers or blocks, typically providing 1 to 5 inches of height without altering the factory suspension. This method enhances aesthetics and allows for larger tires, but does not increase ground clearance. Since a body lift changes the geometry between the body and the frame, you’ll need to select the appropriate body lift height when ordering your Ark Splash Guards from our website to ensure a perfect fit.
Suspension Lift – A suspension lift raises the entire suspension system, including the frame, increasing ground clearance and improving off-road performance. Ranging from 2 to 9 inches (or more), this lift allows for larger tires and better handling on rugged terrain. Because a suspension lift does not alter the body-to-frame geometry, the Stock or Suspension Lift variant of Ark Splash Guards will fit seamlessly, regardless of your suspension lift height.

We’re proud to introduce the latest innovation for your 2023+ Chevy Colorado Trail Boss and ZR2—Ark Splash Guards, built to deliver rugged protection and refined aesthetics for today’s adventurous midsize truck.
Key Features / Advantages


Precision Fit: Specifically crafted to align with the new Gen 3 Colorado's frame, suspension, and engine configurations, our guards offer comprehensive protection against road debris and harsh conditions, ensuring the longevity and pristine condition of your truck.


TriXPoly Blend: Provides outstanding durability and resilience, crafted to withstand the toughest conditions.


Customizable Aesthetics: Choose from a wide variety of colored logos to personalize your vehicle's appearance while adding better protection


Product Variants Explained


Innovative Mud Flaps: Our unique 'Mudflaps' minimize debris and mud flung onto your Colorado's doors from the exposed tire treads. These are not just any universal, flimsy rubber pieces; they are custom-designed specifically for the Gen 3 Colorado's.


Micro Flares: Offering a new distinctive style sure to attract attention, these sleek additions enhance the Colorado's appearance while providing added protection without unnecessary bulk. Practical and aesthetically pleasing, they are a must-have.


Mid Mud Flaps: Striking a perfect balance between our Micro Flares and full Mud Flap offerings, these Mid Mud Flaps provide robust protection against road debris and mud while maintaining a sleek, streamlined look. They are designed to offer enhanced coverage without compromising the Colorado's aesthetic appeal, making them an ideal choice for those seeking both functionality and style.


Sold in Sets: Our Ark Splash Guards are sold in convenient sets (Passenger and Driver Sides), ensuring you have everything you need for a complete installation. This makes it easy to outfit your Colorado with comprehensive protection right out of the box.


Complete Kits: Our complete kits provide splash guards for all four sides (Front/Rear, Passenger and Driver Sides) of the vehicle, offering full coverage and maximum protection for your Colorado. This all-in-one solution ensures your vehicle is fully equipped to handle any off-road challenge.


Bundle and Save: Mix and match our products at a discount with our bundle and save option. Customize your Colorado with the perfect combination of accessories while enjoying significant savings.


Additional Information


Base Material Color: The base material color of our splash guards is black, providing a sleek and versatile look. Customers can choose from a variety of colored logos to further personalize their Colorado.


All Hardware and Installation Instructions Included: Each set comes with all necessary hardware and detailed installation instructions, making the installation process straightforward and hassle-free.


Durable Construction: Made from high-quality materials to withstand tough conditions and provide long-lasting protection.


Easy Installation: Designed for a straightforward installation process, allowing you to quickly and efficiently equip your truck with top-quality protection.


Comprehensive Coverage: Offers full coverage to protect against road debris, mud, and harsh weather conditions, ensuring your truck remains in pristine condition.


Enhanced Safety: Engineered to improve safety by reducing the amount of debris kicked up by the tires, which can be hazardous to other vehicles on the road.


Weather Resistant: Built to withstand extreme weather conditions, ensuring reliable performance in any environment.


American Made Quality
Ark Splash Guards are proudly made in America, reflecting our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. Designed for easy installation, they allow Colorado owners to quickly and efficiently equip their trucks with top-quality protection. Our 1-year no-questions-asked refund policy underscores our confidence in the quality and effectiveness of our products.
 
Transform Your 2023+ Chevy Colorado ZR2/Trailboss Today
Experience a new level of protection and style with Ark Splash Guards for your Chevy Colorado. Ideal for those who value innovation, performance, and appearance, these splash guards are an essential upgrade for the modern and powerful truck. Stand out with Ark Splash Guards and enjoy unmatched protection, durability, and a fresh style that will leave you admiring your vehicle.

name: 96-02 3rd gen 4Runner Long Travel Rear 5100 Shocks (0-3")
description:
Bilstein B8 5100 shock absorbers are designed as a direct fit solution for lifted trucks and SUV's. These shock absorbers feature a monotube design which provides consistent fade free performance. B8 5100 shock absorbers utilize a unique, velocity sensitive, digressive piston which reacts to changing road conditions. All B8 5100 shock absorbers are tuned for each specific application to assure optimal performance is achieved. B8 5100 shock absorbers offer a significant improvement in ride quality, handling, and comfort.
 These longer travel shocks fit the 3rd gen 4runners but are actually 4th gen 4runner shocks. They provide an extra 1" of travel over the 3rd gen Bilstein shocks. You will need a longer spring with this option and extended brake lines.

name: Morimoto XB HYBRID LED HEADLIGHTS | TACOMA (12-15)
description:
SPECIAL: This particular body style Tacoma will always be special to us. when our business was founded back in 2005, this Tacoma was hot off the press with its basic halogen reflector headlights--making it prime for a projector retrofit. We've always loved our friends at TacomaWorld, and the guys there have always showed us so much love too over the years. now we're returning the favor once again with the intro of the Morimoto Hybrid LED headlights for the facelifted 12-15 model year Toyota Tacoma.
BANG FOR THE BUCK: The XB Hybrids share many of the same core components developed for the top of the line series from Morimoto, without some of the features that make them considerably more expensive. That said... these new Tacoma headlights Hybrid are hardly a compromise. True reflector optics for the DRL. Killer light output. Good Looks... all wrapped up inside of an OEM-grade housing and backed with a solid five-year warranty.
NO COMPETITION: Now lets take a minute to compare the Tacoma LED headlights from Morimoto with some of the other options out there. You've got the cheap ebay specials that look cheesy, are poorly built, and don't perform well. You've got projector retrofits for OEM headlights which pack a lot of bang for the buck but take time to build, and then you've got the XB Hybrids. For us, there are very few alternatives at this price point that can compare to the Morimoto's for your 12-15 Tacoma.
HIGH PERFORMANCE: When it comes to light output, these Tacoma headlights wont disappoint at all. we know Tacoma guys arent all about the bling, light output is important too--and there is no lack of luminosity here. the Hybrids have a powerful, wide, and bright led low beam projector, and a dedicated led high beam projector too. their optics were specially developed just last year specifically for use the hybrid lineup to produce an amazing beam pattern despite the affordable price point. unlike other "headlight upgrades" that look decent, these look great, and will most definitely make driving in the dark a pleasure. Bring on the night!
DOT APPROVED: for the ladies and gents that care about street legality, their dual led projector optics meet & exceed all SAE, DOT, and FVMSS108 regulations. they come out of the box aimed to factory specs, and are also fully adjustable for those of you with lifted Tacos.
PLUG AND PLAY: When it comes to wiring, it doesn't get much easier than this. The Hybrid headlights are designed to work on your Tacoma without any mods. They will plug into the factory H4 three-pin connector for the stock headlights, and will work seamlessly without any issues at all. Since they re-use the stock halogen turn signal bulb, you don't have to worry about adding resistors or any of that nonsense to avoid hyper flashing either. You will however have to add one cable, which comes included, to power the DRL--but that's plug n play with one of the slots in your fuse box. No big deal.
BENCHMARK: Morimoto. The Automotive Lighting Benchmark. We are globally recognized as the brand to beat when it comes to aftermarket lighting upgrades for the automotive aftermarket. No other brand blends performance, quality, and style quite like we do. Our vast product line covers today's most popular trucks and cars. If you don't see it, trust that we can make it. Whether you're interested in something off the shelf or a brand new product designed exclusively for you: Connect with Morimoto Today!

name: Morimoto XB LED HEADLIGHTS (Amber DRL) | TACOMA (16-23)
description:
NO SUBSTITUTES: If you're still running oldschool halogen headlights on your "Third Gen" Toyota Tacoma, then you're just behind the times! Thankfully the new Morimoto XB LED headlights: Look great. Are well-built. Have a virtually infinite life span. An unbeatable warranty, and out-perform the alternatives. Easily making them the best LED headlights on the market today for the Tacoma aftermarket
SECOND GEN UPDATE: The Tacoma XB headlights broke the mold when they came out as the first set of performance aftermarket headlights for the Tacoma... but some early adopters weren't 100% satisfied with the light output. In true Morimoto fashion, nothing gets left alone for long and that's why now the new Gen 2 version is in distribution!
MORE LIGHT OUTPUT: The original Tacoma XB's used 2 projectors for low beam, and one dedicated high beam. The new setup utilizes all three projectors for the low beam, and has a dual Bi-LED setup. The results? 33% more light output for low beam mode, 100% more output in high beam mode, and a better distribution of light with more foreground (on the ground directly in front of the truck) for improved visibility while cornering. Asked and answered!
START-UP SEQUENCE: And if the optical upgrades weren't enough, the badass start up sequence has been added too. When the Daytime Running light kicks on, the projectors illuminate in a two-stage sequence before turning back off in. A video is worth a thousand words here... so make sure to watch the one embedded in the listing to see that in action! While it does absolutely nothing for performance, you can't deny the cool-factor!
OEM PLUS: We live, eat, and sleep headlights. While the Tacoma LEDs from Morimoto cost a bit more relative to other options in the aftermarket; as the saying goes "you pay for what you get". We've seen it all, and their fit and finish is far superior to everything else out there. Guaranteed.
PERFORMANCE: We've always been blown away by the fact that the other brands don't even consider how well their headlights perform on the road at night. Most often, they're a downgrade compared to even the standard halogen setup, and that's a shame. The good news is that Morimoto's XB LED headlights produce a well defined beam pattern with a great amount of width, intensity, and a proper distribution of light.
DOT APPROVED: Make no mistake, these will produce a much different [better] result than slapping some LED replacement bulbs into your stock housings. Their quad-projector optics meet & exceed all SAE, DOT, and FMVSS108 regulations when aimed properly...and that's easy to do with their integrated adjusters.
PLUG-N-PLAY: Wiring is easy too! The LED headlights are designed to work on your Toyota Tacoma without any modifications. They will plug into the factory connectors for the stock headlights and each assembly includes all necessary connectors, rubber seals, and pigtails for a plug n play install. No error codes, no flickering, hyper-flashing, or radio interference. They can easily be removed, and will not void your factory warranty.
SEQUENTIAL LED DRL: Game Changer! Their LED daytime running light is powered by Osram 5000K LEDs and is insanely bright, easily visible during the day. A separate optic that's dedicated to the turn signal function uses amber LED's to produce a full sequential turn signal. While that feature will cause others to mistake your truck for an Audi; for those who are a bit more traditional they can also be setup to run as solid on/off style signals too.
WELL-BUILT: Their UV-coated polycarbonate lens will resist the test of time, ensuring your truck's new headlights will look good as new for many years to come. The PPS plastic housing is light-weight and much stronger than comparable alternatives. The die-cast aluminum heat-sinks inside the housings provide more than an adequate amount of cooling for the OEM grade Osram LED chips that produce the light. These complete headlights may be new to the market, but Morimoto's XB LED fog lights have proven themselves perfect after 5+ years out now, which is confidence inspiring.
THEY LOOK: Amazing. At least in our opinion! The subtle elements incorporated in their design are more than enough to make them stand out, but they're clean enough to be considered top of the line original equipment to those who don't know any better. The piano black trim and smoked gray reflectors keep the color scheme neutral, and the quad kuria-optic projectors are as modern as it gets.
 
*NOTE:
Trucks w/o OEM LED DRLs must have DRL OFF setting on light switch.

name: RCV Ultimate IFS CV Axle Set for Toyota FJ Cruiser ('07-'14), 4 Runner ('03+), Tacoma ('05+), Lexus GX460 ('03+) & Lexus GX470 ('03+)
description:
RCV Ultimate IFS CV Axles for Independent Front Suspension are designed to overcome the limitations of Toyota FJ Cruiser, 4 Runner, Tacoma, Lexus GX460 and Lexus GX470 IFS axle shafts. Ultimate IFS CV Axles provide increased strength that original equipment axle shafts just can't match. Even if you have big tires and big power there are no worries.  Ultimate IFS CV Axles are low maintenance, and are backed with a "No Questions Asked" limited lifetime warranty against breakage. Our IFS CV axles meet and exceed the strength of a straight axle swap, while allowing you to maintain the traction, smoothness and control of your IFS. Ultimate IFS CV Axles are race proven, and used by racers in Ultra 4, SCORE, BITD, and more.  Put the power down with confidence!
The axles feature a double-offset inboard CV joint that is comprised by 1-inch balls and 300M internal components.  The outboard CVs utilize our Dana 60 architecture with combination of 4340 & 300M components optimized for maximum strength.  The center bar is 35 spline 300M, the strongest in the industry.  The RCV developed moly SPEC grease is used in the CVs to control heat build-up in even the most extreme use environments. Black oxide coating is standard.
Optional nickel plating is available for extra corrosion resistance in salty environments. - contact us for details, or use our Custom Axle Configuration Form.
We have tested these axles in a variety of applications and different environments with great success.  This axle set is designed to be a direct factory replacement.  Long travel suspension options available.
Axles as tested and designed to fit the following models but not limited to:  2005 to present Toyota Tacoma 4x4, 2007-2014 FJ Cruiser, 2003 to present Toyota 4runner 4x4, Lexus GX460 ('10-'13) & Lexus GX470 ('03-'09)

The ROAM Vagabond is a durable foldout rooftop tent that sleeps 2-3 people on top of a high-density foam mattress. This all-weather tent can be easily installed on a variety of roof racks and takes minutes to pitch, wherever you find yourself at the end of the day. name: Stage 1 Lift Kit Bilstein/OME  – 3rd Gen 4Runner (1996-02)
description:
Current lead time: 1 - 4 weeks
This lift kit can be configured with:

Bilstein 5100 front shocks
Front old man emu medium to heavy-duty lift coils

Rear old man emu coils ranging from medium to heavy duty

FRONT SETUP


Setup 1: OME 880: Stock front weight. 1.5 inch lift

Setup 2: OME 881: Stock front weight. with 2 inch of lift with 5100’s

Setup 3: OME 883: 200 + lbs additional front weight heavy bumper 2.5 inch Lift

Setup 2: OME 890 coils 2.5″ Lift normal weight

name: Stage 1 Lift Kit Bilstein/OME  – 5th Gen 4Runner (2010+)
description:
Current lead time: 1 - 4 weeks
This lift kit can be configured with:

Bilstein 5100 front shocks
Front old man emu medium to heavy-duty lift coils
Rear extended Bilstein 5100 shocks allowing for longer travel
Rear old man emu coils ranging from medium to heavy duty

885/889 medium coils = no aftermarket front/rear weight887/898 heavy coils = you are running front/rear weight
If you are looking for a nice way to lift your 5th Gen Toyota 4Runner without breaking the bank, the Stage 1 Lift Kit from Bilstein is a great way to start. Whether you have added weight or not, the Stage 1 Kit will fit your needs to achieve 2.5” of lift on your 5th Gen.
With the Stage 1 Lift there are two options, the first for those of you with a stock 5th Gen. This includes Bilstein 5100’s w/ OME 885 coils, as well as OME 889 rear coils. These will give your ride a nice smooth feel, while also giving it the lift you desire for on and off-road performance.
Option 2 gives you a more heavier weight coil. For those of you with bumpers, armor, and other add-ons you will want to go with this option. You still get the Bilstein 5100’s, but the heavier coils in front, OME 887, and rear OME 898, make sure you can handle whatever is on your vehicle for on and off-road performance.

Front shocks must be used on lowest setting. 
Front shocks will need to be assembled - top hats are re-used from your stock setup. Many shops are able to compress and swap the top hats on.
We are using the coils to achieve lift, not the shocks, moving the perch up on the front shocks will be more than 3″ of lift, it will ride rough and void warranty.

name: 03-09 4Runner Rear Hyrbid Bumper - DIY KIT
description:
Info to know before you order:

THIS IS A DIY KIT!


This bumper will not work with body lifts without leaving a gap. It will work with stock height and suspension lifted vehicles.


There may be small imperfections on the surfaces of the parts, such as small areas of surface rust or shallow scratches caused during the manufacturing or shipping processes.


Any grille guard tubing will not be welded to the bumper due to shipping constraints and to cut down overall shipping costs.

A little about the bumper:

The new open hybrid design is stronger, more lightweight, and offers the best approach angle of any other True North bumper to date. Not to mention it looks badass!


We wanted to be able to offer the best fitment possible so we took our design a step above all the other fabrication companies out there and had the front of the truck laser-scanned! This allows us to model the bumper within our cad programs using a virtual representation of the truck that is accurate to within .005 inches!


The frame mounting plate, winch plate, and skid supports are all 1/4 gauge HRPO steel. The remainder of the bumper is made of 3/16 HRPO steel and 1.75" .120 wall tubing!


We realized that these bumpers are going to be mounted on 20ish-year-old vehicles and the chances of each and every one of them having a perfect frame with no previous front end damage are slim. So in order to offer the best fitment possible, we made all the mounting points slightly oversized. This will give you a little adjustability when mounting. Depending on how far you need to adjust you will possibly need to use washers as shims between the bumper and the frame. New bolts and washers are included.

Lead time: 2 Weeks. This is only an estimate and may occasionally be slightly longer or shorter depending on the workload and availability of parts. This does not include time in transit after shipment. Please contact us for updates on your order.

name: 96-02 4Runner Alpha Front Bumper - DIY KIT
description:
Info to know before you order:


THIS IS A DIY (DO IT YOURSELF) KIT! It is shipped as multiple pieces and the customer welds it themselves.


This is NOT A WINCH BUMPER. There is no room or mounting points for a winch inside the bumper.



In order to get the tightest fitment and strongest mounting design possible, there is some modification required. You will have to trim 2 inches off the front of the frame rails on the vehicle. This will not reduce the integrity of the frame. After cutting, clean and coat the cut area with some spray paint to prevent any rust issues.


This bumper will not work with body lifts without leaving a gap. It will work with stock height and suspension lifted vehicles.



There may be small imperfections on the surfaces of the parts, such as small areas of surface rust or shallow scratches caused during the manufacturing or shipping processes. 


Any grille guard tubing will not be pre-coped and will be slightly oversized.

A little about the bumper:

Most DIY bumper kits include dozens of small flat pieces of metal and require hours of lining up, welding, and grinding, which can be incredibly frustrating and time-consuming. We set out to design a DIY bumper kit unlike any other. All the parts are laser cut and press bent with slotted and tabbed edges. This means it requires a fraction of the welding and grinding compared to other kits. With the built-in tabs, the bumper pieces line up perfectly and don't require you to consistently be checking measurements. You don’t even need to have the bumper on the 4runner to be able to tack it together.


We wanted to be able to offer the best fitment possible so we took our design a step above all the other fabrication companies out there and had the front of the truck laser-scanned! This allows us to model the bumper within our cad programs using a virtual representation of the truck that is accurate to within .005 inches!


The frame mounting plate, winch plate, and skid supports are all 7 gauge HRPO steel. The inner main vertical plates and underwing supports are 3/8” thick steel. Shackle mounts are 1/2" steel. All other sheet metal parts are made of 11 gauge HRPO steel. All tubing is 1.75 OD 11 gauge ERW steel.


We realized that these bumpers are going to be mounted on 20ish-year-old vehicles and the chances of each and every one of them having a perfect frame with no previous front-end damage are slim. So in order to offer the best fitment possible, we made all the mounting points slightly oversized. This will give you a little adjustability when mounting. Depending on how far you need to adjust you will possibly need to use washers as shims between the bumper and the frame. New bolts and washers are included.


Weighs roughly 80 lbs. Any grille guard tubing will add to this.

Lead time: 2 Weeks. This is only an estimate and may occasionally be slightly longer or shorter depending on the workload and availability of parts. This does not include time in transit after shipment. Please contact us for updates on your order.

description:
Info to know before you order:


THIS IS A DIY (DO IT YOURSELF) KIT! It is shipped as multiple pieces and the customer welds it themselves.


There may be small imperfections on the surfaces of the parts, such as small areas of surface rust or shallow scratches caused during the manufacturing or shipping processes.


The bumper is intended for off-road use only. There is no tow capacity rating. 

A little about the bumper:

Most DIY bumper kits include dozens of small flat pieces of metal and require hours of lining up, welding, and grinding, which can be incredibly frustrating and time-consuming. We set out to design a DIY bumper kit unlike any other. All the parts are laser cut and press bent with slotted and tabbed edges. This means it requires a fraction of the welding and grinding compared to other kits. You don’t even need to have the bumper on the vehicle to be able to tack it together!


We wanted to be able to offer the best fitment possible so we took our design a step above all the other fabrication companies out there and had the front of the truck laser-scanned! This allows us to model the bumper within our cad programs using a virtual representation of the truck that is accurate to within .005 inches!


Materials: The frame mounting brackets are 1/4" hrpo steel. The center section, swingout attachment plates, and side support braces are 3/16" hrpo steel. Sides and end caps are 10 gauge (0.1345") hrpo steel. Shackle mounts are 1/2" hr steel with a 1" hole and are welded through to the frame brackets. Crossbeams between frame bracket and hitch are 2x2x3/16 square tubing. Hitch is 2.5x2.5x3/16 square tubing.



We realized that these bumpers are going to be mounted on 20ish-year-old vehicles and the chances of each and every one of them having a perfect frame with no previous damage is slim. So in order to offer the best fitment possible, we made all the mounting points slightly oversized. This will give you a little adjustability when mounting. Depending on how far you need to adjust you will possibly need to use washers as shims between the bumper and the frame. New bolts and washers are included. 


Works with stock height/suspension lifted vehicles as well as 1/2", 1", 1.5", and 2" body lifts! Brackets are sized for 2" body lift with a modular tab/slot design to move the frame mounting plate up/down to your preferred height. Simply cut/grind off the unused section of the brackets below the mounting plate (cut marks already indented on edges of brackets). However, it should be noted that vehicles with body lifts will look a little odd as the brackets will be protruding up to 2" below the rest of the bumper.



The base bumper weighs roughly 95 lbs. 


A little about the swingout:

Max recommended tire size is 35".


Wheel bolt pattern is 6x5.5 with M12x1.50 studs. Lug nuts not included.


The license plate will need to be relocated. 


The square tubing connecting the wheel mounting plate to the swingout is cut oversized and is adjustable. So depending on your wheel offset you can cut it to the length you need. It can also be angled to your preferred position.


Materials: The hinge brackets, wheel mounting plate, and swingout wheel support plate & braces are 1/4" hrpo steel. The latch bracket and logo brace are 3/16" hrpo steel. Round tubing is 1.75" OD x 11 gauge ERW. Square tubing is 2.5x2.5x3/16.



Hinge is a dual shear design. Main pin is a 3/4" alloy steel shoulder bolt (stronger than grade 8). Uses oil embedded high load flanged sleeve bushings. The outer tube that the swingout welds too is 1.75" OD x 3/8" wall DOM tubing. Mounts to the bumper using six 1/2" alloy steel bolts or can be welded.  


Latch has a 2000 lb holding capacity and safety lock.


T-handle spring plunger offers added security and locks swingout in the closed position. Also locks swing out when opened to 100°.



Swingout weight including latch, hinges, and all hardware is around 40 lbs.


Lead time: 2 Weeks This is only an estimate and may occasionally be slightly longer or shorter depending on the workload and availability of parts. This does not include time in transit after shipment. Please contact us for updates on your order.

name: Spidertrax 1.25" Blue Wheel Spacers for Toyotas
description: Bigger tires need clearance and adding that suspension lift is only half the battle. Spidertrax 1.25" thick, 6 on 5.5" bolt circle, 6061T6 aluminum spacers are an easy way of spacing out front and rear late model Toyota axles that run hub centric wheels (wheels using shank style lug nuts). This added spacing is necessary for keeping those larger tires from crashing into your frame rails and suspension links at full turn. Simply bolt-on like a wheel, and off to the trails you go.Each kit comes with 2 wheel spacers, 12 M12x1.5 Grade 10.9+ 4140 wheel studs (pre-installed), 12 lug nuts, and a package of thread locker. Each wheel spacer is anodized in blue, using a double anodizing process for twice the corrosion resistance. In addition, each wheel spacer is wheel and hub centric for a perfect fit.

name: SPC Adjustable Upper Control Arms for 03+ 4Runner, 07-14 FJ Cruiser, 03+ Lexus GX
description:
When lifting a vehicle it’s common for the factory upper control arm to no longer work, or no longer be able to achieve proper alignment specs. This is normally the case when lifting the your Toyota.
SPC has made an upper control arm that not only requires minimal maintenance, but also gives -/+ 2 degree of caster, and 0/+4 degree of camber. They are also designed around OEM ball joint and bushings, meaning these will last quite a long time. These allow for accurate alignments after lifting your Toyota, as well as better handling and tire wear.
Both the ball joint and bushings are able to be greased in this kit, and have minimal exposure. This allows these upper control arms to last quite a long time, and prevent premature wear and tear.
The SPC upper control arms include both driver and passenger UCA’s.

name: SPC Adjustable Upper Control Arms for 2005-2022 Tacomas (25470)
description:
When lifting a vehicle it’s important to keep alignment specs close to factory for proper wear and tear on the tires, but more importantly for proper drooping. SPC upper control arms allow full droop rather than limit such as OEM does.
The SPC Upper Control arm for 2005-2022 Tacomas is a great option for upgrading, whether your stock control arm is failing, or you have lifted your vehicle.
Alignment specs are important to keep near factory, and when not doing so causes uneven wear and tear on tires, ultimately shortening their lifespan. This is a big problem when lifting a vehicle as factory alignment specs are no longer able to be achieved. If running extended shocks the SPC upper control arms can handle the excess droop.
The SPC UCA is also greaseable with the ball joint and bushings. Meaning you can keep them properly lubricated to extend their lifespan compared to OEM and other makers. Because their UCA is made with a ball joint instead of a uniball, you can expect them to outlive many other competitors.
No matter what you throw at these UCA’s, they will be able to handle it. If you have any questions regarding their fitment on your ’95-04 Tacoma, or ’96-02 4Runner please give us a call and we will be happy to help you out.

name: ARB Hydraulic Recovery Jack
description:
ARB Hydraulic Long Travel Recovery Jack 9 Locating Points Maximum Capacity 4409 lbs
What happens when engineers get creative and bring hydraulic technology into the recovery space? There’s little doubt that the traditional farm jack is a handy piece of equipment to have when you’re driving off-road. You can use it to move your vehicle out of awkward situations, lifting vehicles to fill in voids beneath the tires or even as a bead breaker when you have to make a tire repair. But, as we all know, farm jacks can be dangerous. They’re inherently unstable and there are countless YouTube videos of users getting injured from a rogue handle or getting their hands caught between the handle and the body of the jack.
With this problem in mind, ARB’s team of engineers was determined to come up with a better solution to the unsafe farm jack problem. The focus was to design a safer and easier mechanical jack while being lighter and more compact. Adding a new dimension to traditional techniques, the long-travel ARB JACK is backed by the unique power of hydraulic technology. Kicking into action when even the lightest force is applied to the handle, the hydraulics will smoothly jack the vehicle up at .5in increments with each downward maneuver. While in action, a black rubber body bumper shields the vehicle from the risk of damage during the recovery. The easy-to-access red lowering lever ensures lowering the vehicle is achieved swiftly and safely thanks to the two-stage descent feature and safety stop. With the press of a lever, the user is able to adjust the lower speed between a slow or rapid descent.
Carefully designed on the basis of matching ergonomic form with safe and reliable functionality, the handles high position and top pivot function provide users with ultimate control while preventing the need to uncomfortably kneel down to operate. Standing true to its adaptable character, JACK features an adjustable foot that can be rotated 360° via the shaft to match the angle of the terrain and reach a firm, stable connection between the base and ground.
Includes:

Hydraulic Long Travel Recovery Jack
Jack Storage Bag

Product Features:

Hydraulics Smoothly Jack The Vehicle Up At .5 in Increments
2-Stage Descent Feature + Safety Stop
Adjustable Foot With 360° Rotation
Made From Hardy Aircraft Grade 6061 T6 Aluminum Throughout Body
9 Locating Points For a Wide Range For the Adjustable Hook
Impressive Max 4409-lb Lifting Capability

name: Ball Joint Upper Control Arms for 2003 - 2021 4Runner and FJ Cruiser
description:
Please allow up to 6 weeks for production.



There are multiple issues when lifting your vehicle with stock upper control arms. Both the geometry and strength are compromised due to over articulating the factory arms. We solved these problems by designing our arms with increased castor and repositioned the pivot angles reducing stress on the joints. The increased castor allows for proper alignment and improved handling. We have also upgraded the factory ball joints with heavy duty Moog ball joints. For the inner pivots we used durable urethane bushings with grease fittings for easy servicing. All of the components on our upper control arms are rebuild-able or replaceable to make this product last a lifetime. The arms come preassembled and include detailed instructions for easy installation.


Wheel Travel: Additional 1” of travel compared to stock
Amount of Lift: Allows for 0-3” of lift
Track Width: Stock
\Maximum Backspacing: 4.75”

Minimum Rim Size: 16”
Coil over Shock Size:Factory or OEM replacement coilovers


Wheel Travel / LiftThe upper control arms must be paired with OEM replacement coil overs to lift the vehicle. They offer an additional 1” of down travel compared to the stock upper control arms. These arms are compatible with King, Fox, Bilstein, ADS and Icon coil overs. Do not install these upper control arms with coil spacers that over articulate the suspension.

Tire InfoThe upper control arms will allow for 33” tires but the front section of the cab mount may need to be cut to avoid tire rubbing while turning. In addition the front bumper may require trimming for proper tire clearance.

name: Performance Lower Control Arms for 2003 - 2021 4Runner and FJ Cruiser
description:
Please allow up to 6 weeks for production.











The Dirt King performance lower control arms were developed to withstand off road abuse and not compromise the vehicles on road driving characteristics. The most vulnerable suspension component on the 4Runner's and FJ Cruiser's are the lower control arms. The Dirt King control arms have additional ground clearance and include 1/8" aluminum skid plates for added protection. If there's any major contact the internal ribbed design keeps the crucial parts intact so your not left stranded on the trail. The outer pivots on the lower control arms utilize heavy duty Moog ball joints which are low maintenance and easily serviceable. Controlled side by side testing was done between Moog ball joints and the industry standard 1" uniball for the outer pivot. The result was better on road tracking with the Moog ball joints. Other benefits include a sealed housing to eliminate noise, longer life span, and readily available at auto part stores.  Delrin bushings were chosen for the inner pivots after weighing all the pro and cons between vulcanized rubber bushings, poly bushings, and uniballs. Here are some of their major flaws; vulcanized bushings restrict the amount of articulation, poly bushings are too soft for the amount of force on the lower control arms causing premature wear and noise, uniballs quickly become contaminated with dirt making them noisy and they're also expensive to replace. Additional features on the Dirt King lower control arms include recessed shock mounting with a drain hole and accepts all types of shocks and struts. It also accommodates for bump stops and limit straps. Progressive steering stops limit the steering throughout the suspension cycle to allow for maximum steering without over articulating the CV's or tie rods. This product is a direct bolt on application with all necessary hardware included. The arms are coated with a durable black powder coat and all the wearable components are replaceable for a product that will last a lifetime.






Track Width: Stock
Maximum Tire Size: 35”
Maximum Backspacing: 4.75”
Minimum Rim Size: 16”
Compatible with factory sway bar: Yes
Bump Stop Size: 2.0 x 2.0
Coil Over Shock Size: OEM replacement coil overs


Tire InfoIf installing 35” tires modifications to the wheel wells and bumper will need to be made for proper tire clearance.

description: The Mojab branded T-shirts are designed for every adventure, whether you're hitting the off-road trails, setting up camp under the stars, or simply embracing the day-to-day grind. Crafted with your active lifestyle in mind, these tees provide the ultimate combination of comfort and style. Featuring our logo, they symbolize your passion for exploration, making them the perfect attire for any occasion. From thrilling off-road escapades to casual outings, our branded T-shirts are the ideal choice for adventurers who seek comfort and fashion wherever they go.
